scope: Retail-client route and normalized field semantics for Map clientbound battle-result opcodes 0x0139 through 0x013C.

textSelection.rowContract: worldMasterTextId=0 skips row text; a nonzero ID is rendered unchanged and is not derived from numericValue, effectId, commandId, or actor identity.
textSelection.headerContract: A nonzero headerControlValue is a separate header-level worldMaster text ID rendered once through the common text pipeline, then cleared; it does not alter per-row selection.
textSelection.parameterContract: commandId supplies template slot e802; source/target actor identities supply e908/e909; numericValue supplies e80b; effectId is masked to 24 bits and supplies e80c; textParam supplies template-specific e80d. rowOrdinalOrFilter is not a render argument.
textSelection.corpusContract: The closed retained corpus has 531 packets, 622 rows, 502 nonzero text-ID rows, 120 zero-ID rows, and 29 distinct joined nonzero worldMaster IDs. 0x013B remains a bounded absence.

unresolvedBoundaries: CommandResultX18Packet and BattleActionX18Packet remain aliases because no 0x013B capture distinguishes their runtime naming.
The exact meanings of header render-context fields, presentation flag bits, textParam, rowOrdinalOrFilter, and the final indirect Rapture/Vfx clip target remain unresolved.
Client-data row joins establish commandId and worldMasterTextId table identity only; they do not prove command behavior, scaling, status application, or final damage computation.
